entries.detail: D1 adapter evidence records synchronized respiration-channel presence and statistics, but no respiration waveform is materialized for deterministic R3 target extraction.
D1 source condition 'apnea' and related protocol strings are retained as provenance; no onset/offset is guessed.
R3 does not finalize an X-second persistence threshold or model history length.
The D0 TRAIN compact window audit contains partial hold overlaps but no full-window event; ABSENT remains a supported contract state and is not fabricated.
